headline: Binance Loses Over $6 Billion in Major Crypto Hack
summary: Hackers stole over $6 billion in digital currency from Binance in what could be the largest crypto heist in history, prompting the company to pledge to cover the losses.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, and security breaches of this scale raise severe systemic concerns for digital asset liquidity, market confidence, and regulatory oversight.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange exploits can trigger broader market sell-offs and liquidations across digital assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar exploit on a leading crypto platform drains liquidity and damages investor sentiment across the entire digital asset sector.
